name: revenue
title: Monthly subscription review
subtitle: Observed month-end MRR, grouped by currency. Not accounting revenue.

sections.title: Monthly record
sections.sql: select * from v_monthly order by month desc,currency

sections.title: Latest movements
sections.sql: select name,currency,prior_mrr,mrr,change,initcap(replace(movement,'_',' ')) as movement from v_movements where month=(select max(month) from monthly_mrr) order by change nulls last

sections.title: Owners and due dates
sections.sql: select * from v_attention order by kind,name

sections.title: Actions
sections.sql: select c.name,a.title,a.owner,a.due_on,a.status from actions a join customers c on c.id=a.customer_id order by a.due_on
